qian_vs_ukb.explanation: The two files are the SAME summary statistics (identical A1/A2/Z across all SNPs; only the N column differs). This is a relabelled copy of the exposure, NOT an independent BMD GWAS. A comparison between them is circular and CANNOT adjudicate the 3.5426 scale-reconstruction factor.
qian_vs_ukb.reason_cannot_adjudicate: Pair is circular (same source). Even if independent, Z-only files cannot reveal a beta-scale factor; the correct test needs beta&SE from a genuinely independent BMD GWAS (--independent mode).
